summary: Nine hour delay leaving Miami for Bogota
story: My flight from Miami to Bogota on August 14 was scheduled for 7:30 in the morning and left at 4:50 in the afternoon because the crew had timed out and the airline had to bring in a replacement. I took a day room at the airport hotel to get some work done, had lunch, and paid for a taxi to the hotel and back. The total is $210 and the receipts are attached, along with the airline's confirmation of the delay.

items.description: Taxi to the hotel and back

documents.name: Meridian Air delay confirmation
documents.content: Meridian Air. Flight MA 205 Miami MIA to Bogota BOG, August 14, 2026. Scheduled departure 07:30. Actual departure 16:50. Cause: crew duty time limit, replacement crew required. Issued to passenger Victor Salazar.

documents.name: Receipts
documents.content: Miami Airport Hotel, day room, August 14, 2026: $112.00. Cafe Versailles, Concourse D, August 14, 2026: $58.00. Taxi, August 14, 2026, two trips: $40.00.
